propositions: The bridge schedule must be changed from three 40-minute cron entries to a single hourly entry (23 * * * *) now that RECONCILE_CONTINUOUS is disabled
The cadence test must be retargeted to assert uniform 60-minute gaps, exactly one schedule entry, and a non-zero minute instead of the 40-minute three-entry form

The CloudWatch bridge_run_failures alarm becomes structurally unfirable at hourly cadence with the old tuning (threshold=1, evaluation_periods=1) and must be retuned to threshold=0, evaluation_periods=2, datapoints_to_alarm=2 to detect two consecutive failed hours
All documentation, workflow comments, test pins, and Jenkinsfile references to 40-minute cadence must be updated to reflect the new 1-hour worst-case latency and hourly schedule
The Terraform state change to monitoring_bridge.tf leaves Terraform Drift red until an operator runs terraform apply with AWS credentials
